outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit rate
cohort: Multiple pregnancies at Bakirkoy Maternity and Children's Hospital between February 2008 and January 2009.
finding: While maternal age, premature rupture of membranes rate, and cesarean delivery rate were significantly higher in the IVF group, there were no significant differences between IVF and spontaneous multiple pregnancies in demographic features, hospitalization stay, NICU admission rate, mortality, and congenital malformation rate.
